newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average closed 20.72 points higher at 5,888.46 last Friday. For the week, the Dow rose 49.94 points.
** The Tokyo stock market is closed on Monday due to a public holiday.
** Indonesia's largest state-owned Bank BNI is scheduled to launch a roadshow on Monday ahead of a listing on the Jakarta stock exchange later this year.
** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.43 points, or 0.61 percent, to close at 568.99 points last Friday following active foreign buying of selected big-capitalised stocks.
** Brokers said they expected Jakarta share prices to be mixed on Monday, with profit-taking in selected heavyweights following gains last week.
** On Monday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,318.50/19.00 in early trade against an opening of 2,319.00/20.00.
** Lippo Securities, Lippo Life and Lippo Bank of the Lippo Group following announcement last week that it would sweeten terms of its restructuring plan.
** Property firm Jababeka on market talk it has signed a deal with a Singapore-based company to develop and operate an industrial park in West Java.
** Astra on market talk of a possible take-over and rights issue. The firm denied to comment on the take-over talk and said there was no plan to announce a rights issue.
